name: Prepare operator-authorized v1.6.0 MINOR release: changelog roll-up and version anchors (pre-tag; post-tag observed facts are the separate closeout contract's scope)

files_create.purpose: Externalized command output for every AT: exact invocation first, raw output, EXIT:<code> last; tag/workflow/bootstrap captures recorded only after actual external results, with the observed tag/commit/workflow facts they prove.
Independent Mode A/B gate records with empty issue arrays required for approval.
Independent evaluator contract-review and QA verdict records.

Post-tag close-out contract, mirroring the release-v1.5.0-closeout precedent: authored in this PR as status proposed (gated independently before execution); carries ALL observed-fact updates (ROADMAP Latest-released roll, operator_gates EXECUTED row, HANDOVER release note, manifest observed fact, README installed-payload line post-re-bootstrap) plus the post-release CHANGELOG Unreleased ledger refresh; executed only after the tag, release workflow and bootstrap rehearsal exist.

files_modify.purpose: Roll the [Unreleased] section into a dated [1.6.0] section per release-train Section 4: keep all landed Unreleased bullets (features 115-119, 120-123, 126-128, 133, planning/maintenance/self-governance records), author the missing feature 129 entry with its explicit boundary (feature-scope complete; full-live qualification remains features 131/132), and add the release-tier note (MINOR per Section 3.2, no breaking governance changes). Do not rewrite released [1.5.0] or older sections.
framework.version to 1.6.0 only; modules, capabilities and all other fields unchanged.
Version/change_log top entry 1.6.0 dated at release; accurate current payload/release status; historical entries preserved.

Roll current release pins v1.5.0 -> v1.6.0: the implementation must end with exactly 7 'v1.6.0' occurrences (raw bootstrap URL, GOVERNANCE_TAG and --tag examples, release link) and exactly 1 remaining 'v1.5.0' occurrence — the installed-payload statement, which is closeout scope. Exact counts asserted by AT3's companion guard. Preserve operator GA declaration note and links.

Exactly three 1.6.0 anchors — the meta framework-version content value, the footer version span, and the tagged GitHub blob href for the operator-gates decision page — mirroring the v1.5.0 amendment; exact counts asserted by AT3's companion guard; zero remaining '1.5.0' occurrences. Pages publishes docs/guide only so sibling relative links would 404.

Bump document version/change_log; set the document's release disposition line, in the current-position section (the first '## Current'-prefixed section, '## Current position — ...'), to exactly 'Release in preparation: v1.6.0' (one line, PREPARED-clause per release_closeout.py, which accepts either disposition phrase naming the version); observed tag/commit/workflow facts and the 'Latest released tag: v1.6.0' roll land ONLY in the post-tag closeout contract, which replaces this same line in this same section; remove any v1.6.0 preparation bullet; preserve historical phase records and prior release lines.

Bump version/change_log with a dated PREPARED row for v1.6.0 under the recurring H-FRAMEWORK-RELEASE gate (preparation record, no execution claim); the observed EXECUTED facts (date, tag, commit, workflow run) are appended ONLY by the post-tag closeout contract; retain H-GA decision, exceptions and H-CONSOLIDATION outstanding status.

Add a dated current-status note 'v1.6.0 release in preparation (tag pending)' above the historical snapshot; bump document version/change_log; historical bodies unchanged. Also refresh the PR-#112-era frontmatter description anchor that names the current release status (e.g. 'Current v1.5.0 release status' -> preparation wording). The release-EXECUTED note with observed facts is the closeout contract's scope.

Append a PREPARED v1.6.0 release-preparation note to the phase ledger (no observed facts, no execution claim); the observed post-release fact lands ONLY via the post-tag closeout contract; phase statuses and steps unchanged.

non_goals: No changes to the installed .nizam/ payload in this repository beyond a reviewed, operator-authorized re-bootstrap performed AFTER the v1.6.0 tag exists; source edits never update the installed release automatically.
No rewriting, back-dating or re-tiering of released [1.5.0] or older CHANGELOG sections, the v1.5.0 GA decision, or historical dossier/phase evidence.
No source tool, schema, workflow, bootstrap, template, methodology, ecosystem or registry semantics changes; the version-anchor diff is documentation and pins only.
No contract or verdict resets: existing .agent/contracts/*.json records, validator/QA verdicts and run_state history remain immutable; this contract appends new records only.

Features 130, 131 and 132 are NOT part of this release: no feature-130 completion claims, and no full-live SBCL/runtime conformance claim for feature 129 (full-live qualification remains features 131/132 and is disclosed as pending in the release notes).

No superiority or comparative-performance claims: agentic-excellence material stays no-claim; the balanced comparative proposal in the Unreleased entries remains an unexecuted proposal with pinned sources only.

No tag creation, push, release publishing or merge by the Generator; those remain Orchestrator release mechanics executed only after dual-gate approval and AT completion (release-train Sections 2 and 6).

No whole-tree fixed-anchor byte guards: per NDEBT-040, any byte-guard assertions in this contract's scope checks target only the feature-list/contract JSON files or use parsed-JSON decomposition, so live documentation edits elsewhere cannot invalidate them.

verification.acceptance_test: AT4: Only the nine authorized product files plus framework-only release artifacts changed relative to this contract's committed base; untracked paths fail closed; byte-guards are NDEBT-040-safe (feature-list/contract JSON only, or parsed-JSON decomposition); changed planning docs carry bumped frontmatter versions.
verification.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,subprocess
base='d86e1160a60e21c485235741e30372facee0e9d9'
product={'CHANGELOG.md','NIZAM.json','CONTEXT.md','README.md','docs/guide/index.html','docs/planning/ROADMAP.md','docs/planning/operator_gates.md','docs/planning/HANDOVER.md','docs/planning/manifest.json'}
def auxiliary(p):
 return p=='.agent/run_state.json' or p=='.agent/contracts/release-v1.6.0.json' or p=='.agent/contracts/release-v1.6.0-closeout.json' or bool(re.fullmatch(r'\.agent/(validator|qa)/release-v1\.6\.0-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.json',p)) or bool(re.fullmatch(r'\.agent/evidence/release-v1\.6\.0-tag/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+',p)) and '..' not in p or p.startswith('.agent/evidence/release-v1.6.0-contract/')
r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--name-status',base],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True)
seen=set()
for l in r.stdout.splitlines():
 parts=l.split('\t');assert len(parts)==2,l;status,p=parts
 if p in product: assert status=='M',(status,p);seen.add(p)
 else: assert auxiliary(p) and status in ('A','M'),(status,p)
assert seen==product,(seen,product)
for p in subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.splitlines(): assert auxiliary(p),p
# NDEBT-040-safe parsed-JSON decomposition guards (no whole-tree byte anchors)
contract=json.load(open('.agent/contracts/release-v1.6.0.json'))
assert contract['contract_id']=='release-v1.6.0' and contract['status'] in ('approved','implemented','complete')
assert json.load(open('NIZAM.json'))['framework']['version']=='1.6.0'
assert json.load(open('docs/planning/manifest.json'))['current_phase'] is not None
import re
def ver_at(rev,path):
 out=subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{rev}:{path}'],text=True,capture_output=True)
 if out.returncode!=0: return None
 m=re.search(r'^version:\s*(\S+)',out.stdout,flags=re.M)
 return m.group(1) if m else None
for path in ['docs/planning/ROADMAP.md','docs/planning/operator_gates.md','docs/planning/HANDOVER.md']:
 b=ver_at(base,path); c=ver_at('HEAD',path)
 assert b and c and b!=c,(path,b,c)
print('Scope guard passed: nine product files plus authorized release artifacts only; parsed-JSON guards intact; planning-doc frontmatter versions bumped')
PY
verification.expected: Exit 0; exact nine product paths plus only authorized contract/validator/QA/evidence additions; no fixed-anchor whole-tree byte guards; ROADMAP/operator_gates/HANDOVER frontmatter version strictly bumped vs base (parsed decomposition)

design_notes.release_classification: MINOR per methodology/06_release_train.md Section 3.2: new functionality landed since v1.5.0 (features 115-123, 126-129, 133 across phases 015-017/021 plus start-path gating and audit-readiness planning records) with no schema narrowing, no removed/renamed shipped files and no breaking governance change; the release tier note must record this classification.
design_notes.changelog_rollup_gap: The [Unreleased] section on origin/main (verified 2026-10-16 at bfd15d10) covers features 115-119, 120-123, 126-128 and 133 but has NO feature 129 entry even though ROADMAP records feature 129 complete (PR #109 merge 96cd3573, QA-approved); the roll-up must author it, stating feature-scope completion only and that full-live qualification deliberately remains features 131/132. Do not claim live conformance anywhere in release notes or anchors.
design_notes.operator_decision: On 2026-10-16 the operator authorized PR management and merge: 'manage, triage as necessary, your PR's and once clean merge as appropriate'. PR #112 (audit-readiness: planning current-view refresh + lifecycle re-anchoring) merges to main with green CI BEFORE this contract's implementation phase, so the release base already carries the audit-readiness current view.
design_notes.implementation_gate: Status stays proposed until independent Mode A and evaluator contract-review verdicts both approve with all issue arrays empty; the annotated tag v1.6.0 is cut and pushed by the Orchestrator only after both gates approve and AT1-AT4 pass on the committed candidate; AT5-AT8 then run against the real tag, workflow and bootstrap results.
design_notes.verification_order: AT1-AT4 run serially on the release PR branch; AT5-AT8 are close-out ATs that execute only after the tag and release exist and must capture the observed tag SHA, workflow run id and bootstrap resolved_sha. AT2 is captured ONCE, pre-re-bootstrap, on the still-installed v1.5.0 payload against the candidate tree; the post-re-bootstrap payload re-capture is the closeout contract's evidence, not a second AT2. The installed .nizam/ payload in THIS repository is refreshed only via a reviewed re-bootstrap after the tag exists (non-goal boundary).
design_notes.scope_base: base_revision is TO_BE_SET_BY_ORCHESTRATOR_AT_COMMIT in TWO places — the base_revision field and the AT4 embedded guard script — and the Orchestrator substitutes BOTH with the same actual value (the main merge commit d86e1160a60e21c485235741e30372facee0e9d9 of PR #112, the post-audit-readiness main tip) when committing this contract on the release branch. All AT4 diff-scope assertions resolve against that committed base.
design_notes.ndebt_040_guard_design: AT4 uses path-allowlists plus parsed-JSON decomposition on NIZAM.json and docs/planning/manifest.json. No git-show byte-equality anchor against any whole file outside the contract/feature-list set, so later live documentation edits cannot stale-fail this contract's guards.
design_notes.two_contract_split: Round-1 gate finding (both independent reviewers): a single contract cannot require observed tag/workflow facts in files_modify while its own AT1-AT4 gate the tag — a sequencing contradiction. Resolution per the v1.5.0 precedent: this contract is PRE-TAG ONLY (anchors + PREPARED disposition lines); release-v1.6.0-closeout.json (created in this PR, status proposed) owns every observed post-tag fact and is independently gated before execution. ROADMAP keeps 'Release in preparation: v1.6.0' through the tag (release_closeout.py accepts that phrase in both pr and tag modes), so AT5 stays green pre-closeout.
design_notes.frontmatter_sweep: The four touched planning docs (ROADMAP.md, operator_gates.md, HANDOVER.md, manifest.json) must each carry a bumped version + dated change_log entry per NDS Sec 7: AT1's C8 enforces version-bump-vs-changelog over the PR diff for every changed governed document, and AT4's parsed-decomposition guard asserts the frontmatter version field strictly bumped vs base for the three planning .md files (docs/planning/manifest.json has no version field; its consistency guard is the parsed-JSON phase-pointer check in AT4). HANDOVER-2026-10-16.md is NOT in this contract's scope.
design_notes.manifest_target_phase: The manifest ledger note target is phase 021-receipt-input-maintenance (the currently complete phase on the release base); phase 020 remains in_progress and untouched.
